the energy consumption of IoT devices is a critical issue, especially when it comes to the security services.
security services can be made energy efficient by applying energy-efficient techniques at different levels of the security stack.

energy efficiency in IoT security is not an easy issue to deal with, and that it requires a deep understanding of the security mechanisms in order to be able to apply energy-efficient mechanisms in the right way.

the energy-efficient security mechanisms are highly dependent on the security primitives used and the target application.
energy-efficient mechanisms in security solutions are not only limited to cryptographic primitives, but they can be applied at different levels.
